rules.mfi_definition: Jia et al. 2019 Sentinel-2 Mangrove Forest Index
rules.calibration_scope: PLOT_076 uses 13-STC drone-density spatial holdout calibration when promoted; all other plots use NDVI > 0.25 conservative default.
rules.mfi_role: diagnostic only: MFI > 0.0; not merged into vegetation coverage
rules.submerged_mangrove_signal_definition: MNDWI > 0.0 AND MFI > 0.0 AND NOT vegetation_proxy

dates.ingest_provenance: local native Earth Search C1 TIFF; exact month; registry scope; explicit radiometry

source_provenance.radiometry_interpretation: native Earth Search C1 per-band STAC metadata; legacy observations preserved without reinterpretation

ingest_notes.rule: missing registry observation only; exact month; no substitution
